Chapter 1031: 1 A Simple Retreat (Seeking Monthly Tickets) _3

Chapter 1031: Chapter 1 A Simple Retreat (Seeking Monthly Tickets) _3

… [Your perception defies the heavens, re-comprehending the evolution pathway of the Martial Tao, perfecting the Water Martial Arts…] …

Most of Lin Yuan’s mind was focused on this, and the perfection and development of various branches of the Martial Tao had a great impact on him. As the Ancestor of Martial Arts, even if he hadn’t traversed these paths, he could wield them as if they were an extension of his arm. “If these branches are perfected using the power of the five elements of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth, their potential will undoubtedly be great.”

Lin Yuan thought.

The rotation of the five elements is almost flawless, and it balances destruction and creation.

But wanting to comprehend Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth, and master these five forces at the Second Layer?

Condensing the Five Elements Primordial Spirit at the Fifth Layer? The difficulty is too high.

If it were within the universe, Lin Yuan even doubted whether such a genius existed, but in the Chaos Void? With the bloodlines of various spectacular life forms rampant, and with many monstrous talents, there is still hope of traversing this path.

Those who step into the twelfth level of Martial Tao through the Five Elements Martial Arts, their combat power, upon initially entering the Path Splitting Realm, would likely be close to its peak.

Of course, this path is very difficult, requiring not only the comprehension of the five elements at the Second Layer but also the cultivation of the Five Elements Primordial Spirit, the Five Elements Rules, and so on.

Lin Yuan earnestly perfected the branch path of the Five Elements Martial Arts, not minding what future Five Elements Martial Arts cultivators might pose as a threat to him.

Firstly, with Lin Yuan’s innate talent and aptitude, on the same level of cultivation, he believes no life could compare to him.

Even more so with those who come after?

While they take one step, Lin Yuan would have already moved ten, a hundred steps forward. How can there be any comparison?

Moreover, Lin Yuan’s combat power and foundation are not limited to Martial Tao alone, even if there are martial cultivators who break the ironclad rules and also tread the Yin-Yang Taiji path.

In the same realm, they would still be crushed by Lin Yuan.

The same path, but is the cosmic foundation within the body the same? Lin Yuan’s Path Splitting Realm internal universe is on par with the Chaos Venerable, there are countless rules comprehended, Secret Techniques, and so on.

There’s simply no competition.

More crucially, as the Ancestor of Martial Arts and the founder of this great Tao of Martial Arts,

Lin Yuan inherently wields an indescribable, unstoppable ‘overcoming’ power against those who follow in the Martial Tao.

Just like a mouse meeting a cat, it is naturally suppressed to death.

For example, from the perspective of potential, the Five Elements Martial Arts, the cycle of the five elements is not much inferior to the Yin-Yang Taiji.

But with all other external conditions identical, like realm strength, inner world, numerous rule insights, Secret Techniques, Divine Skills, and so on, being equal, the Five Elements Martial Arts Evolutionary would still be crushed by Lin Yuan.

The reason for being crushed here is that in front of Lin Yuan, the martial arts cultivator’s full strength cannot be brought out, being innately suppressed and constrained.

In equal strength, even if the opponent is stronger than Lin Yuan, as long as they are based on Martial Tao, branching into endless paths, they would be thoroughly suppressed by Lin Yuan, without any power to resist. … “Space Martial Arts…”

Lin Yuan began to develop and perfect the corresponding branch of martial arts based on space.

Compared to the smooth development of various martial arts branches previously, Lin Yuan clearly encountered bottleneck difficulties in perfecting Space Martial Arts. “If one were to develop a martial arts branch based on space?”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, lost in thought. “Space is too vast, yet also too flimsy.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, and there was another point he hadn’t mentioned, which was that the difficulty is too high.

To base it on space means mastering the power of space at the Second Layer of Martial Tao.

A Second Layer Martial Arts Evolutionary, who hasn’t even fully grasped and developed the power of their physical body and soul, let alone comprehend and master the power of space?

As for condensing the Space Primordial Spirit at the Fifth Layer, it requires a certain level of understanding of space power, otherwise, how could one control the power of space to condense the Space Primordial Spirit? “Space Martial Arts will be temporarily shelved; there’s no need to develop it.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, mainly because the threshold for this martial arts branch is too high.

The life forms that can master the power of space at the Second Layer must have a certain pure space bloodline.

Such beings are too rare.

Simply put, the general accessibility of Space Martial Arts is not high, far from being as simple and introductory as ordinary Metal Martial Arts or Water Martial Arts. “Time Martial Arts?” Lin Yuan began to experiment with more.

Compared to Space Martial Arts, the difficulty of Time Martial Arts soared another level, and Lin Yuan had no intention of perfecting this branch.

He’s merely pondering the deeper essence of Martial Tao through this martial arts branch. “Space Martial Arts…Time Martial Arts, then what about Space-Time Martial Arts?”

Lin Yuan’s interest was piqued, as time and space began to intertwine before him.

With space-time as the foundation, the potential of the martial arts branch extended from this is vast, but this martial arts path is almost impossible to even get started. “Space-Time…”

Lin Yuan pondered the feasibility of Space-Time Martial Arts and the application of space-time, and his thoughts immediately shifted from Martial Arts to space-time.

Suddenly.

Countless accumulated insights into space-time erupted explosively.

Thousands of years of space-time comprehension in the Main Universe, clear observation of space-time fluctuations within the Source World, and after entering the Chaos Void, sensing the vast space-time of the boundless Chaos Void… [Your perception defies the heavens, penetrating analogy, reaching the Eightfold Realm in space-time comprehension…]

In an instant, the vast space-time of the Chaos Void began to slowly clear up before Lin Yuan,

Lin Yuan looked down, with the vast Ancient Ming Chaos Continent fully in view, and even Lin Yuan’s gaze faintly looked toward the deepest part of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, where a chaotic aura figure was in closed cultivation. “Is it the Ancient Ming Venerable?”

Lin Yuan’s expression was contemplative, and he immediately stopped paying attention.

With the perception of a Chaos Venerable, continuing to watch is highly likely to be noticed. “What an unexpected delight.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, “I didn’t expect that in this retreat to perfect and develop martial arts branches, I would end up comprehending the Eightfold Realm of Space-Time?”
